support.title: Help & support
support.q1: How do I pay for my order?
support.a1: After checkout, transfer the amount to one of MOVA's accounts shown on the payment page, then upload the receipt. The admin will review it and confirm your payment.
support.q2: Why was my order split into several orders?
support.a2: If your cart has products from more than one shop, a separate order is created for each shop, and each needs its own payment receipt.
support.q3: How do I track my order?
support.a3: Go to Account → My orders and open the order to see the payment status and each item's progress until delivery.
support.a4: You can cancel while the order is awaiting payment. After payment is confirmed, contact us on WhatsApp.
support.q5: How do I become a seller on MOVA?
support.a5: Create a new account and choose the "Seller" account type, then complete your shop details and ID images. The admin will review your request shortly.
